text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks, which means finding anything that could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to create contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a risk actually occurs. Finally, you should keep monitoring risks, because new ones can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay prepared and avoid serious trouble.
